question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 88, 99, 47, 79, 12, 79, 76, 17 and 61 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 60.

Deviations from 60: +28, +39, −13, +19, −48, +19, +16, −43, +1

Sum of deviations = 122 − 104 = +18

Average deviation = 18 ÷ 9 = +2

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average deviation = 60 + 2 = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62.**
